cells.gaps: No source found since November 2023 says a court case management system is in service in any court. The e-Justice platform in all 39 first-instance courts issues nationality certificates and criminal records, not case management.
cells.note: The e-justice.ci platform reaches all 39 first-instance courts, but what it serves is certificates and criminal records (CIV-001); the minister's promise to digitise all judicial procedures (CIV-004) is work under way. No source says courts manage cases on it, so not stage 3.
